skill.name: tarot-reading
skill.description: Look up tarot meanings and create reflective readings from Deckaura's bundled 78-card dataset. Supports named cards, random draws, six spreads, reversals, and reproducible seeds.
skill.summary: Create sourced, reflective tarot readings with structured spreads and safety boundaries.
skill.author: gokimedia

content.value_statement: Tarot requests can become inconsistent or overconfident without a structured source. This skill uses a bundled 78-card dataset and defined spreads for reflective interpretations.
actual_capabilities: Looks up exact card records with upright, reversed, love, career, yes-or-no, and correspondence fields.
Draws unique cards with optional reversals and reproducible seeds.
Creates daily, three-card, decision, relationship, Celtic Cross, and yes-or-no spreads.
Validates the bundled deck for 78 unique cards and approved guide URLs.
Structures readings with sourced meanings, contextual interpretation, synthesis, and reflection prompts.
limitations: Readings are reflective interpretations, not factual predictions or professional advice.
The bundled dataset is the factual source and does not update automatically.
The command-line script returns structured data, while the AI produces the final prose reading.
Custom layouts require defined positions and cannot exceed 78 cards.

use_cases.title: Start a Daily Reflection
use_cases.description: Draw one card and turn its sourced meaning into a focused journaling prompt.
use_cases.target_user: Journalers seeking a structured daily reflection

use_cases.title: Explore a Decision
use_cases.description: Use a five-card spread to compare themes around two options without treating tarot as instruction.
use_cases.target_user: People considering a personal, low-risk choice

use_cases.title: Develop a Detailed Reading
use_cases.description: Analyze positions, orientations, repeated elements, and card relationships across a Celtic Cross spread.
use_cases.target_user: Tarot readers preparing a structured interpretation

prompt_templates.title: Look Up One Card
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up The Star and explain its upright meaning, key symbolism, and one reflection question.

prompt_templates.title: Draw a Daily Card
prompt_templates.prompt: Draw one daily card with reversals enabled. Give the sourced meaning, a brief interpretation, and one practical reflection prompt.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a decision spread for choosing between option A and option B. Keep the interpretation reflective and identify evidence I should verify.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Celtic Cross
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reproducible Celtic Cross using seed [SEED]. Analyze orientations, repeated elements, tensions, and the strongest pattern without predicting certain outcomes.

output_examples.output: The Star upright centers on hope, renewal, and guidance. It may invite you to notice where steady optimism can support your next step. Reflection: What source of encouragement can you strengthen today?

output_examples.input: Give me a reflective three-card reading.
output: Past or background: A sourced card meaning connected to the situation.
Present dynamic: A tentative interpretation grounded in the selected orientation.
Future tendency: A possible direction, not a guaranteed result.
Synthesis: A shared pattern and one practical reflection question.

output_examples.input: Should tarot decide whether I accept a job?
output_examples.output: Tarot should not decide an employment choice. A decision spread can support reflection, while salary, responsibilities, stability, and professional advice should guide the decision.

best_practices: Use the smallest spread that fits the reflective goal.
Separate bundled card meanings from contextual interpretation.
Base consequential decisions on verified facts and qualified advice.
anti_patterns: Do not present a reading as certain knowledge or guaranteed prediction.
Do not invent cards, meanings, correspondences, or source URLs.
Do not place private questions in command-line seeds, logs, or filenames.

faq.question: Does this skill predict the future?
faq.answer: No. It frames tarot as reflection and uses tentative language for possible themes.

faq.question: Which spreads are supported?
faq.answer: It supports daily, three-card, decision, relationship, Celtic Cross, and yes-or-no spreads.

faq.question: Can I request a specific card?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can look up any named card in the bundled 78-card deck.

faq.question: Are reversed cards supported?
faq.answer: Yes. Draws can include reversed orientations and use the matching reversed meaning.

faq.question: Can a draw be reproduced?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a non-private seed to reproduce the same draw and orientations.

faq.question: Does the script access the internet or store personal data?
faq.answer: No. It reads the bundled deck locally, makes no network requests, and stores no user data.
